notes.title: The Excavation of Hob's Barrow is out now!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

After 3 years of hard work, [b]The Excavation of Hob's Barrow[/b] is out now!

Our Victorian folk horror adventure has been published by the great [b]Wadjet Eye Games[/b], giving us the opportunity to include full voice acting (from an amazing cast) and achieve a level of polish that is a cut above our previous games. 

Please do check it out, we hope you enjoy it! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1182310/The_Excavation_of_Hobs_Barrow/

(The game had previously been known as INCANTAMENTUM earlier in development)

Thanks for your support,
Shaun, John and Laurie
[i][b]Cloak and Dagger Games[/b][/i]

notes.title: INCANTAMENTUM - our next game now has a Steam page!
notes.content:
Our next game is [b]INCANTAMENTUM.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1182310/INCANTAMENTUM/

A mysterious letter brings noted barrow-digger Thomasina Bateman to the isolated and somewhat unwelcoming village of Bewlay, England. A subsequent series of strange events in this ancient and sodden landscape prove that this will be no ordinary dig for Miss Bateman.

The excavation of Hob's Barrow will uncover more than was bargained for...

[b]INCANTAMENTUM [/b]will be out later this year. Please do add it to your wishlists, it helps us a lot :) 

Thanks for your support,
Shaun
Cloak and Dagger Games

notes.title: The best horror games to put the spooks up you this Halloween
notes.content:
It’s Halloween! We’ve put the Hivemind Of Horror into a spooky jar of bubbling green liquid, and it’ll be pumping horror-themed articles onto the site today.

Halloween didn t really used to be that big of a deal in the UK, back when I were a kid. But now it is, so most people go to Halloween parties, or spooky club nights, or some other similar kind of terrifying celebration. I like to keep things traditional though, which means staying in on October 31st and kicking back with some Video Game Entertainment. Also I m COO of The NoSleep Podcast, and since we ve been working on Halloween content since around July, I think I deserve a break by the time it hits October s end.

So if, like me, you re after some video game recommendations in order to spend Halloween night alone, or even something to play after the festivities, then look no further. I ve compiled a list of thirteen (ooh) of the best horror games to be had this year.
